name: anki-cards-collector
description: Local-first Chromium extension for collecting real language from the web and reviewing it before sending it to Anki.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run check:manual-migration-helper && npm run build && node scripts/check-built.mjs
scripts.package:store: npm run build:release && npm run check:store && node scripts/package-release.mjs
